title: Reason codes
body:
# Reason codes

Status: current. Revision RX-0412, published 2026-04-12.

The intake form offers one reason code per ticket. Each code maps to one category of the ticket taxonomy. A retired code is no longer offered; tickets that still carry it follow the code in the last column.

| Code | Reason | Category | State | Replaced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RC-101 | Card charged twice | billing-charge | active | - |
| RC-102 | Unexpected renewal charge | billing-charge | active | - |
| RC-110 | Refund status | billing-refund | active | - |
| RC-111 | Refund to a closed card | billing-refund | active | - |
| RC-115 | Bank dispute opened | billing-charge | active | - |
| RC-121 | Sign-in failure | account-access | active | - |
| RC-120 | Account question | how-to | active | - |
| RC-130 | API server errors | api-errors | active | - |
| RC-142 | Export failure | data-export | active | - |
| RC-140 | Export help | how-to | active | - |
| RC-150 | App crash | mobile-app | active | - |
| RC-160 | Feature suggestion | feature-request | active | - |
| RC-170 | How do I | how-to | active | - |
| RC-171 | General question | general | active | - |
| RC-180 | Service unavailable | outage-report | active | - |
| RC-190 | Suspected account takeover | account-security | active | - |
